rootCauses.title: Database appears unreachable or empty
rootCauses.description: Manifest check returned fail with zero jobs. DB may be offline or the schema hasn't been applied.
evidence: manifest_snapshots query returned error or zero rows with jobs present

rootCauses.title: Cloud storage not configured
rootCauses.description: R2 credentials are absent. Assets cannot be stored or verified. Set R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_ACCOUNT_ID.
evidence: CLOUD_PROVIDER=noop or R2 env vars missing

repairs.title: Verify DB connectivity and run schema push
repairs.description: Check DATABASE_URL secret, confirm Postgres is running, and run: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push
repairs.estimatedImpact: Restores all manifest and job tracking functionality.

repairs.title: Configure R2 credentials
repairs.description: Add R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_ACCOUNT_ID, and CLOUD_PROVIDER=r2 to environment secrets.
repairs.estimatedImpact: Enables all cloud storage features including asset persistence and monitoring uploads.
